findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 4 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 20 questions numbered 1-20; by section: 4.1 2, 4.2 2, 4.3 2, 4.4 2, 4.5 4, 4.6 2, 4.7 2, 4.8 4.

10 pairs (theory 5 marks + numerical 3 marks) covering every derivation in the chapter: work by a constant force, work by a variable force, the gravitational force as a conservative force (with non-conservative friction), power and P = F·v, kinetic energy, absolute potential energy, escape velocity, the work-energy theorem, interconversion of P.E. and K.E., and the energy equation with friction. Numericals use new values recomputed in Python (g = 9.8 m s⁻²). Book corrections followed: the force in Fig. 4.2 is at an angle to the displacement; friction in Example 4.5 is 120 N = 120 kg m s⁻².
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
